name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *open* PR first. It catches fresh issues before they compound, giving us faster feedback loops and cleaner merges. The trade-off is delayed coverage of older PRs, but fresh PRs pose higher risk of introducing new bugs—this prioritizes preventing future problems over cleaning up past ones.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the newest open PR risks exposing *new* edge cases that could destabilize the PR before it’s ready—creating noise that distracts from real fixes. Running PR-Agent on the oldest merged PR tests a stale routing/prompt stack, but it surfaces systemic issues in our legacy code paths that fresh PRs won’t. Settle this by running both: shadow mode on the newest open PR for immediate feedback, and a batch on the oldest merged PR to audit accumulated tech debt.
